/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
inventory = json.loads(Path(\"recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
raw = bytes.fromhex(inventory[\"retained_sample\"][\"value_hex\"])
position = 5

def read_long():
    global position
    encoded = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        byte = raw[position]
        position += 1
        encoded |= (byte & 127) << shift
        if byte < 128:
            return (encoded >> 1) "'^ -(encoded & 1)
        shift += 7

def read_string():
    global position
    length = read_long()
    value = raw[position:position + length].decode("utf-8")
    position += length
    return value

account = read_string()
currency = read_string()
amount = read_long()
print(json.dumps({"check": "offline byte inspection only; no registry or client used", "record_bytes": len(raw), "magic_byte": raw[0], "writer_id_big_endian": int.from_bytes(raw[1:5], "big"), "account": account, "currency": currency, "amount_minor": amount, "source_units": "USD cents", "amount_usd": format(Decimal(amount) / 100, ".2f"), "remaining_bytes": len(raw) - position}))
position = 5
beat = read_long()
print(json.dumps({"hypothetical_heartbeat_first_field": beat, "remaining_bytes": len(raw) - position, "actual_client_acceptance": "not tested"}))
print(json.dumps({"hypothetical_amount_if_interpreted_as_micro_USD": str(Decimal(amount) / 1000000), "understatement_factor": 10000}))'"'"
